map.混响时间越长越好吗？: Is a longer reverberation time better?
map.音乐厅常偏好 1.5–2.5 s 的丰满混响，而会议室、教室宜短（<1 s）以保: Concert halls often favour a rich 1.5-2.5 s, while meeting rooms and classrooms want short values (<1 s) for speech clarity.
